--LINKDETAILLIST(KEEWAYZUP5610X,700) --LINKMYROWDATA DECLARE @MFGFCY VARCHAR(30) = '{0}'; SELECT '' 工单号 ,'' 产品编码 ,0 计划数量 ,0 未提交数量 ,0 已入数量 ,0 可入库数量 ,'' 单位 ,'' LINKROWIDHIDH ,'mui-hidden' LINKROWIDHIDL ,'' id UNION ALL SELECT XWS.MFGNUM_0 工单号 ,XWS.ITMREF_0 产品编码 ,CAST(MFI.EXTQTY_0 AS REAL) 计划数量 ,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(XWS.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) AS REAL) ) 未提交数量 ,CAST(MFI.CPLQTY_0 AS REAL) 已入数量 ,CAST(MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 - ISNULL(XWS.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) AS REAL) 可入库数量 ,ITM.STU_0 单位
,'mui-hidden' LINKROWIDHIDH ,'' LINKROWIDHIDL ,XWS.MFGNUM_0 id FROM XWSMKI XWS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = XWS.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN MFGITM MFI ON MFI.MFGNUM_0=XWS.MFGNUM_0 WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 AND USERID_0 = '#LOGIN_USER#' AND XWS.MFGFCY_0= @MFGFCY GROUP BY XWS.MFGNUM_0 ,XWS.ITMREF_0,MFI.EXTQTY_0,ITM.STU_0,MFI.CPLQTY_0,XWS.UOMCPLQTY_0
SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM XWSMKI WHERE RPFLG_0<>3 AND USERID_0='#LOGIN_USER#' AND MFGNUM_0='#工单号#'
